lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Port Halden, 2148. The sea took the first two storeys and stopped there, politely, as though it had been allocated exactly that much.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: What is left is roof gardens, rope bridges, and the noise water makes in a stairwell that goes down forever.

lines.speaker: dax
lines.text: I came through here as a kid. There were more roofs then.

lines.speaker: player
lines.text: Nine million people. The Enclave census for this whole coast in my century is forty thousand.

lines.speaker: wren
lines.text: Then we are standing in the difference.
